capabilities: Fetch diary emails from an IMAP mailbox
Decrypt AES-256-GCM entry text and attachments locally
Import entries as dated Markdown notes with an index and full collections
Save photo attachments into per-day asset folders
Configure accounts by pasting a .treehole bootstrap config or entering IMAP settings manually
disambiguation: Not a diary-writing app; it only imports entries that were already written in the companion Android app and sent by email.
extras: Works on desktop only (uses Node.js crypto and an IMAP client). Users must enable IMAP on their mailbox and use an authorization code, not the login password. README states the plugin is free, has no ads or telemetry, and stores credentials only locally.
problem: Diary entries written in the Treehole Diary Android app live only in the user's email mailbox; nothing brings them into an Obsidian vault as notes.

relations.evidence: Treehole Diary (树洞日记) is an Android app focused on one thing: writing.

summary: IMAP importer that fetches encrypted diary emails from the Treehole Diary Android app, decrypts them locally, and writes dated Markdown notes and photo attachments.
